2607.14514.title: VTM-Nav: Hierarchical Visual-Topological Memory for Cross-Episode Object-Goal Navigation
2607.14514.paper_summary: Object-goal navigation requires an embodied agent to locate and reach an instance of a specified object category in an indoor environment. Recent training-free approaches leverage vision-language models (VLMs) for open-vocabulary semantic reasoning, but are typically evaluated under an episodic protocol that resets all scene-specific state after each episode. We introduce Cross-Episode Object-Goal Navigation, in which an agent repeatedly operates in the same scene, retains only self-acquired experience, and keeps its model parameters fixed. To support experience reuse, we present \method, a training-free VLM navigation framework with a persistent hierarchical Visual-Topological Memory (VTM). The VTM organizes scene knowledge at room and object levels and retrieves relevant experience through coarse-to-fine matching, providing memory as soft guidance only when it agrees with current observations. A conservative execution guard further mitigates oscillations, blocked motions, and premature stopping. Under a controlled same-scene protocol, we evaluate \method{} on three benchmarks, HM3D v0.1, HM3D v0.2, and MP3D, and compare it with a strengthened WMNav baseline augmented with cross-episode textual memory, while keeping the VLM backbone and action pipeline identical. \method{} achieves the best performance across all three benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness and robustness of structured visual-topological experience reuse across datasets.
2607.14514.paper_summary_zh: 物體目標導航需要一個具身的代理在室內環境中定位並到達指定物體類別的實例。最近的無需訓練的方法利用視覺-語言模型（VLMs）進行開放詞彙的語義推理，但通常在一種情節協議下進行評估，該協議在每個情節後重置所有場景特定狀態。我們引入了跨情節物體目標導航，其中代理在同一場景中重複操作，只保留自我獲得的經驗，並保持其模型參數不變。為了支持經驗重用，我們提出了\method，一個無需訓練的VLM導航框架，具有持久的層次視覺-拓撲記憶（VTM）。VTM在房間和物體層級組織場景知識，並通過粗到細的匹配檢索相關經驗，僅在與當前觀察一致時提供作為軟指導的記憶。一個保守的執行保護進一步減輕了振盪、阻塞運動和過早停止。在受控的同場景協議下，我們在三個基準上評估\method{}，分別是HM3D v0.1、HM3D v0.2和MP3D，並將其與增強的WMNav基線進行比較，該基線增強了跨情節的文本記憶，同時保持VLM骨幹和行動管道相同。\method{}在所有三個基準上達到了最佳性能，展示了結構化視覺-拓撲經驗重用在不同數據集中的有效性和穩健性。
